name: أوامر التشغيل
buyer: Dispatcher and owner of one SME transport office
problem: Trip kilometers, review and billing reports rely on manual documents and uncontrolled corrections.
core_journey: Create trip, record time and kilometers, approve corrections, export consistent monthly report and restore.

data.backup_restore_plan: Office backup and restore to another clean Windows PC.
data.retention_policy: Agree in contract and data law review.

acceptance: Office-only trip is approved with authorization enforced at server.
Corrections appear in history; exports match the displayed totals.
A second clean PC restore recovers trips, users and reports.
